exercises.problemHtml:
Lab 7 — CT Shop: a supplier feed in JSONB and a search box typed without accents

PostgreSQL course · after Chapter 13 · Suggested time: 100 minutes · 10 marks (5 × 2)

1. Overview

The supplier sends product specs as JSON (spec_feed, 16 documents). You survey the feed, merge it into product.attrs, repair and guard the column, serve a filter panel from a GIN index, and build a search that finds Bút bi when the customer types but bi. Same steps as J1, J2, J3, S2 and S4 of the course lab, on the mini data. From Q3 on, the earlier steps are loaded in their reference version. Note: the browser grader has no extensions, so accent folding uses the khong_dau() function of lesson 13.4 instead of unaccent; the trigram part (S3) is the hands-on exercise of 13.4.

General requirements

  • Exact object names (product_attrs_object, product_attrs_types, product_attrs_gin, search_tsv, search_products) — the checks use them.
  • Never compare JSON values as text when they are numbers or booleans: ->> hides the type.

2. Submission files

RollNo_Name_PG_Lab7/
├── Q1.sql    -- J1 · keys that arrive with more than one JSON type (2 marks)
├── Q2.sql    -- J2 · merge the specs into product.attrs (2 marks)
├── Q3.sql    -- J2 · repair the dirty values, then guard the column (2 marks)
├── Q4.sql    -- J3 · a filter panel served by GIN (2 marks)
├── Q5.sql    -- S2 + S4 · search_products(q), typed without accents (2 marks)

3. Data model

spec_feed

FieldTypeNotes
lineintPK
docjsonb{"sku": …, "specs": {…}}

product

FieldTypeNotes
skutextUNIQUE
attrsjsonbbrand, color, tags + the specs
category_idint5 = Bút bi

4. Functional requirements

1. J1 · keys that arrive with more than one JSON type 2 marks

Survey the feed before importing it: return key, json_types, docs for every key of doc->'specs' that appears with more than one jsonb_typeof. json_types = the distinct types joined with ', ' in alphabetical order; docs = how many documents carry the key. Order by key.

Requirements:

  • FROM spec_feed, jsonb_each(doc->'specs') AS e(k, v) + GROUP BY k + HAVING.

2. J2 · merge the specs into product.attrs 2 marks

One UPDATE: for every product whose sku is in the feed, add the keys of doc->'specs' to attrs while keeping brand, color and tags. Products without a feed document stay untouched; the unknown sku CT1207 is ignored.

Requirements:

  • UPDATE … FROM spec_feed; mind the precedence of || and ->.

3. J2 · repair the dirty values, then guard the column 2 marks

The merge is loaded. Repair with the smallest change: pages written as text ("96 trang", "160") → integer, tip_mm "0.5" → number, solar "có" → true, the JSON null gsm removed, the key colour renamed to color. Then add product_attrs_object (attrs is a JSON object) and product_attrs_types (pages, tip_mm, pack, gsm are numbers; solar, exam_ok booleans; tags an array — when present).

Requirements:

  • jsonb_set(attrs, '{pages}', to_jsonb(…::int)) replaces one key and keeps the rest.
  • The CHECK uses jsonb_typeof(attrs->'pages') = 'number' — a missing key gives NULL, which a CHECK accepts.

4. J3 · a filter panel served by GIN 2 marks

Attributes are clean (reference Q3 loaded). Create product_attrs_gin — a GIN index with jsonb_path_ops on attrs — and answer the category page Bút bi (category 5) with the filters ink = dầu and tip 0.7 mm: sku, name, price ordered by price, then sku.

Requirements:

  • Containment attrs @> '{"ink": "dầu", "tip_mm": 0.7}' — the only operator jsonb_path_ops answers, and it compares numbers as numbers.

5. S2 + S4 · search_products(q), typed without accents 2 marks

khong_dau(text) (IMMUTABLE, lesson 13.4) is loaded. Add the stored generated column search_tsv = name with weight A + attrs->>'brand' with weight C, both folded by khong_dau and parsed with the simple configuration; index it with GIN (product_search_gin). Then write search_products(q text) RETURNS TABLE (sku text, name text): all words of q must match (plainto_tsquery on the folded q), best rank first, ties by sku.

Requirements:

  • Fold BOTH sides: the stored document and the user input.
  • A generated column may only call IMMUTABLE functions of its own row — khong_dau qualifies.

5. Grading rubric

#FeatureMarks
1J1 · keys that arrive with more than one JSON type2
2J2 · merge the specs into product.attrs2
3J2 · repair the dirty values, then guard the column2
4J3 · a filter panel served by GIN2
5S2 + S4 · search_products(q), typed without accents2
Total10

Common deductions

  • Filtering numbers or booleans through ->> text ("0.70" ≠ "0.7", '48' > '100").
  • A CHECK that tests attrs->>'pages' as text: "300" written as a string slips through.

6. Submission

Tabs Q1.sql … Q5.sql (J1, J2 merge, J2 repair + guard, J3, S2 + S4). Run = sample checks; Submit = every check and the 10-mark table.

Lab 7 — CT Shop: feed nhà cung cấp trong JSONB và ô tìm kiếm gõ không dấu

Khoá PostgreSQL · sau Chương 13 · Thời gian gợi ý: 100 phút · 10 điểm (5 × 2)

1. Tổng quan

Nhà cung cấp gửi thông số sản phẩm dạng JSON (spec_feed, 16 tài liệu). Bạn khảo sát feed, gộp vào product.attrs, sửa và canh cột đó, phục vụ bảng lọc bằng chỉ mục GIN, và dựng ô tìm kiếm ra Bút bi khi khách gõ but bi. Cùng các bước J1, J2, J3, S2, S4 của lab trong khoá, trên dữ liệu mini. Từ Q3, các bước trước được nạp sẵn bản chuẩn. Lưu ý: máy chấm trình duyệt không có extension, nên bỏ dấu dùng hàm khong_dau() của bài 13.4 thay cho unaccent; phần trigram (S3) là bài làm trên máy của 13.4.

Yêu cầu chung

  • Đúng tên đối tượng (product_attrs_object, product_attrs_types, product_attrs_gin, search_tsv, search_products) — các kiểm dùng chúng.
  • Đừng so giá trị JSON dạng chữ khi chúng là số hay boolean: ->> giấu mất kiểu.

2. Tệp nộp bài

RollNo_Name_PG_Lab7/
├── Q1.sql    -- J1 · keys that arrive with more than one JSON type (2 marks)
├── Q2.sql    -- J2 · merge the specs into product.attrs (2 marks)
├── Q3.sql    -- J2 · repair the dirty values, then guard the column (2 marks)
├── Q4.sql    -- J3 · a filter panel served by GIN (2 marks)
├── Q5.sql    -- S2 + S4 · search_products(q), typed without accents (2 marks)

3. Mô hình dữ liệu

spec_feed

TrườngKiểuGhi chú
lineintPK
docjsonb{"sku": …, "specs": {…}}

product

TrườngKiểuGhi chú
skutextUNIQUE
attrsjsonbbrand, color, tags + the specs
category_idint5 = Bút bi

4. Yêu cầu chức năng

1. J1 · khoá đến với hơn một kiểu JSON 2 điểm

Khảo sát feed trước khi nhập: trả về key, json_types, docs cho mọi khoá của doc->'specs' xuất hiện với hơn một jsonb_typeof. json_types = các kiểu khác nhau nối bằng ', ' theo thứ tự chữ cái; docs = số tài liệu có khoá đó. Sắp theo key.

Yêu cầu:

  • FROM spec_feed, jsonb_each(doc->'specs') AS e(k, v) + GROUP BY k + HAVING.

2. J2 · gộp specs vào product.attrs 2 điểm

Một lệnh UPDATE: với mọi sản phẩm có sku trong feed, thêm các khoá của doc->'specs' vào attrs mà vẫn giữ brand, color và tags. Sản phẩm không có tài liệu trong feed giữ nguyên; sku lạ CT1207 bị bỏ qua.

Yêu cầu:

  • UPDATE … FROM spec_feed; chú ý độ ưu tiên của || và ->.

3. J2 · sửa các giá trị bẩn rồi canh cột 2 điểm

Bước gộp đã nạp. Sửa với thay đổi nhỏ nhất: pages viết dạng chữ ("96 trang", "160") → số nguyên, tip_mm "0.5" → số, solar "có" → true, bỏ gsm là JSON null, đổi khoá colour thành color. Rồi thêm product_attrs_object (attrs là đối tượng JSON) và product_attrs_types (pages, tip_mm, pack, gsm là số; solar, exam_ok là boolean; tags là mảng — khi có mặt).

Yêu cầu:

  • jsonb_set(attrs, '{pages}', to_jsonb(…::int)) thay một khoá, giữ phần còn lại.
  • CHECK dùng jsonb_typeof(attrs->'pages') = 'number' — khoá vắng cho NULL, và CHECK chấp nhận NULL.

4. J3 · bảng lọc phục vụ bằng GIN 2 điểm

Thuộc tính đã sạch (nạp sẵn bản chuẩn Q3). Tạo product_attrs_gin — chỉ mục GIN với jsonb_path_ops trên attrs — và trả lời trang danh mục Bút bi (danh mục 5) với bộ lọc ink = dầu và đầu 0.7 mm: sku, name, price sắp theo giá, rồi sku.

Yêu cầu:

  • Phép chứa attrs @> '{"ink": "dầu", "tip_mm": 0.7}' — toán tử duy nhất jsonb_path_ops trả lời, và nó so số như số.

5. S2 + S4 · search_products(q), gõ không dấu 2 điểm

khong_dau(text) (IMMUTABLE, bài 13.4) đã nạp. Thêm cột sinh lưu sẵn search_tsv = name trọng số A + attrs->>'brand' trọng số C, cả hai bỏ dấu bằng khong_dau và phân tích bằng cấu hình simple; đánh chỉ mục GIN (product_search_gin). Rồi viết search_products(q text) RETURNS TABLE (sku text, name text): mọi từ của q phải khớp (plainto_tsquery trên q đã bỏ dấu), hạng cao trước, bằng nhau theo sku.

Yêu cầu:

  • Bỏ dấu CẢ HAI phía: tài liệu lưu và chuỗi người dùng gõ.
  • Cột sinh chỉ được gọi hàm IMMUTABLE trên chính dòng của nó — khong_dau đạt điều đó.

5. Thang điểm

#Chức năngĐiểm
1J1 · khoá đến với hơn một kiểu JSON2
2J2 · gộp specs vào product.attrs2
3J2 · sửa các giá trị bẩn rồi canh cột2
4J3 · bảng lọc phục vụ bằng GIN2
5S2 + S4 · search_products(q), gõ không dấu2
Tổng10

Lỗi hay bị trừ điểm

  • Lọc số hay boolean qua chữ của ->> ("0.70" ≠ "0.7", '48' > '100').
  • CHECK kiểm attrs->>'pages' dạng chữ: "300" viết dạng chuỗi vẫn lọt.

6. Nộp bài

Các tab Q1.sql … Q5.sql (J1, J2 gộp, J2 sửa + canh, J3, S2 + S4). Chạy thử = kiểm mẫu; Nộp = mọi kiểm và bảng điểm thang 10.

-- ctshop.sql: sample schema + data of this task (READ ONLY — the grader loads it by itself; editing this tab changes nothing).

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

solutionCodeJson.name: Q1.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT k AS key,
       string_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_typeof(v), ', ' ORDER BY jsonb_typeof(v)) AS json_types,
       count(*) AS docs
FROM spec_feed, jsonb_each(doc->'specs') AS e(k, v)       -- jsonb_each keeps the JSON value (and its type)
GROUP BY k
HAVING count(DISTINCT jsonb_typeof(v)) > 1                -- JSON null counts as a type of its own
ORDER BY k;

solutionCodeJson.name: Q2.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
UPDATE product p
SET attrs = p.attrs || (f.doc->'specs')       -- parentheses: || and -> have the same precedence, left to right
FROM spec_feed f
WHERE f.doc->>'sku' = p.sku;

solutionCodeJson.code:
ALTER TABLE product ADD COLUMN search_tsv tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
     setweight(to_tsvector('simple', khong_dau(name)), 'A')
  || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', khong_dau(coalesce(attrs->>'brand', ''))), 'C')
) STORED;
CREATE INDEX product_search_gin ON product USING GIN (search_tsv);

CREATE FUNCTION search_products(q text)
RETURNS TABLE (sku text, name text)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE
AS $$
  SELECT p.sku, p.name
  FROM product p, plainto_tsquery('simple', khong_dau(q)) AS tq   -- fold the INPUT the same way
  WHERE p.search_tsv @@ tq
  ORDER BY ts_rank(p.search_tsv, tq) DESC, p.sku
$$;

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,

  note         text

  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)

CREATE TABLE payment (

  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),

UPDATE product p
SET attrs = p.attrs || (f.doc->'specs')       -- parentheses: || and -> have the same precedence, left to right
FROM spec_feed f
WHERE f.doc->>'sku' = p.sku;
UPDATE product
SET attrs = jsonb_set(attrs, '{pages}', to_jsonb(substring(attrs->>'pages' FROM '[0-9]+')::int))
WHERE jsonb_typeof(attrs->'pages') = 'string';
UPDATE product
SET attrs = jsonb_set(attrs, '{tip_mm}', to_jsonb((attrs->>'tip_mm')::numeric))
WHERE jsonb_typeof(attrs->'tip_mm') = 'string';
UPDATE product
SET attrs = jsonb_set(attrs, '{solar}', to_jsonb(attrs->>'solar' IN ('có', 'yes', 'true')))
WHERE jsonb_typeof(attrs->'solar') = 'string';
UPDATE product SET attrs = jsonb_strip_nulls(attrs)          -- JSON null is not SQL NULL
WHERE attrs @> '{"gsm": null}';
UPDATE product SET attrs = (attrs - 'colour') || jsonb_build_object('color', attrs->'colour')
WHERE attrs ? 'colour';

CREATE FUNCTION plan_nodes(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json; out text := '';
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, COSTS OFF) ' || q INTO j;
  WITH RECURSIVE n(p) AS (SELECT j -> 0 -> 'Plan' UNION ALL SELECT x FROM n, json_array_elements(n.p -> 'Plans') x)
  SELECT string_agg((p ->> 'Node Type') || coalesce(' on ' || (p ->> 'Index Name'), ''), ' / ') INTO out FROM n;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_text(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_rows(q text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json;
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) ' || q INTO j;
  RETURN (j -> 0 -> 'Plan' ->> 'Plan Rows')::numeric::bigint;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_analyze(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF, BUFFERS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;

UPDATE product p
SET attrs = p.attrs || (f.doc->'specs')       -- parentheses: || and -> have the same precedence, left to right
FROM spec_feed f
WHERE f.doc->>'sku' = p.sku;
UPDATE product
SET attrs = jsonb_set(attrs, '{pages}', to_jsonb(substring(attrs->>'pages' FROM '[0-9]+')::int))
WHERE jsonb_typeof(attrs->'pages') = 'string';
UPDATE product
SET attrs = jsonb_set(attrs, '{tip_mm}', to_jsonb((attrs->>'tip_mm')::numeric))
WHERE jsonb_typeof(attrs->'tip_mm') = 'string';
UPDATE product
SET attrs = jsonb_set(attrs, '{solar}', to_jsonb(attrs->>'solar' IN ('có', 'yes', 'true')))
WHERE jsonb_typeof(attrs->'solar') = 'string';
UPDATE product SET attrs = jsonb_strip_nulls(attrs)          -- JSON null is not SQL NULL
WHERE attrs @> '{"gsm": null}';
UPDATE product SET attrs = (attrs - 'colour') || jsonb_build_object('color', attrs->'colour')
WHERE attrs ? 'colour';

ALTER TABLE product ADD CONSTRAINT product_attrs_object CHECK (attrs IS JSON OBJECT);
ALTER TABLE product ADD CONSTRAINT product_attrs_types CHECK (
      jsonb_typeof(attrs->'pages')   = 'number'  AND jsonb_typeof(attrs->'tip_mm')  = 'number'
  AND jsonb_typeof(attrs->'pack')    = 'number'  AND jsonb_typeof(attrs->'gsm')     = 'number'
  AND jsonb_typeof(attrs->'solar')   = 'boolean' AND jsonb_typeof(attrs->'exam_ok') = 'boolean'
  AND jsonb_typeof(attrs->'tags')    = 'array');   -- a missing key gives NULL, and NULL passes a CHECK

CREATE FUNCTION plan_nodes(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json; out text := '';
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, COSTS OFF) ' || q INTO j;
  WITH RECURSIVE n(p) AS (SELECT j -> 0 -> 'Plan' UNION ALL SELECT x FROM n, json_array_elements(n.p -> 'Plans') x)
  SELECT string_agg((p ->> 'Node Type') || coalesce(' on ' || (p ->> 'Index Name'), ''), ' / ') INTO out FROM n;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_text(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_rows(q text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json;
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) ' || q INTO j;
  RETURN (j -> 0 -> 'Plan' ->> 'Plan Rows')::numeric::bigint;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_analyze(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF, BUFFERS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

SET attrs = p.attrs || (f.doc->'specs')       -- parentheses: || and -> have the same precedence, left to right
FROM spec_feed f

SET attrs = jsonb_set(attrs, '{pages}', to_jsonb(substring(attrs->>'pages' FROM '[0-9]+')::int))
WHERE jsonb_typeof(attrs->'pages') = 'string';
UPDATE product
SET attrs = jsonb_set(attrs, '{tip_mm}', to_jsonb((attrs->>'tip_mm')::numeric))
WHERE jsonb_typeof(attrs->'tip_mm') = 'string';

UPDATE product SET attrs = jsonb_strip_nulls(attrs)          -- JSON null is not SQL NULL
WHERE attrs @> '{"gsm": null}';

WHERE attrs ? 'colour';

CREATE FUNCTION plan_nodes(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json; out text := '';
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, COSTS OFF) ' || q INTO j;
  WITH RECURSIVE n(p) AS (SELECT j -> 0 -> 'Plan' UNION ALL SELECT x FROM n, json_array_elements(n.p -> 'Plans') x)
  SELECT string_agg((p ->> 'Node Type') || coalesce(' on ' || (p ->> 'Index Name'), ''), ' / ') INTO out FROM n;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_text(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_rows(q text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json;
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) ' || q INTO j;
  RETURN (j -> 0 -> 'Plan' ->> 'Plan Rows')::numeric::bigint;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_analyze(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF, BUFFERS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

CREATE FUNCTION plan_nodes(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json; out text := '';
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, COSTS OFF) ' || q INTO j;
  WITH RECURSIVE n(p) AS (SELECT j -> 0 -> 'Plan' UNION ALL SELECT x FROM n, json_array_elements(n.p -> 'Plans') x)
  SELECT string_agg((p ->> 'Node Type') || coalesce(' on ' || (p ->> 'Index Name'), ''), ' / ') INTO out FROM n;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_text(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_rows(q text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json;
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) ' || q INTO j;
  RETURN (j -> 0 -> 'Plan' ->> 'Plan Rows')::numeric::bigint;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_analyze(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF, BUFFERS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);
